newsitem.title: USA: Anthem completes $40/shr tender for Acordia.
newsitem.headline: Anthem completes $40/shr tender for Acordia.

text.p: Anthem Insurance Cos Inc said Thursday it has completed a $40 a share cash tender offer for Acordia Inc, which along with 8.7 million shares held by an Anthem unit gives it about 98 percent of Acordia's stock.
A total of 4,045,472 shares of Acordia, including notices of guaranteed delivery, were tenedered in the offer, Anthem said.
Anthem began the tender offer to purchase all of Acordia's shares on June 6.
The tendered shares, along with 8,692,056 shares owned by Anthem's subsidiary AICI Acquisition Corp, constitute about 98 percent of Acordia's outstanding stock, Anthem said.
It said it now can acquire the remaining shares of Acordia for $40 each by merging AICI into Acordia without a meeting or vote of Acordia stockholders in a so-called "short form" merger.
Antehm is a mutual insurance company. Acordia is an insurance brokerage firm providing insurance broking and consulting services.
